forms.detail: Salvia divinorum Epling & Játiva-M. (authority from EUDA's bibliography), family Lamiaceae (formerly Labiatae); DEA: a perennial herb in the mint family.
EUDA: fresh leaves, and dried and crushed leaves; DEA: fresh and dried leaves; seeds, plant cuttings and whole plants are also sold.
EUDA: dried leaves fortified with extracts from other leaves ('5X to 50X extracts'); DEA: extract-enhanced leaves of various strengths (e.g. 5x, 10x, 20x, 30x).
EUDA: leaf extracts and aqueous ethanol tinctures made from leaves; DEA: liquid extracts purported to contain salvinorin A.
